note: Scripture follows the Kinh Thánh (Cadman, 1925; public domain), taken from the ebible mirror vie_kt because Take Root was unreachable from this session. That mirror text carries encoding damage (VNI leftovers on name-initial capitals such as Aùp-ra-ham for Áp-ra-ham, 'k”' for 'kỳ', four cp1258-mojibake verses and one stray word); it was repaired as pure typography before use, with no wording changed. Rows were derived by measurement: `mined` only when the translator claimed Cadman wording AND the block contains either a quoted span that is a verbatim Cadman substring (case-insensitive, for Murray's capitals) or a run of six consecutive Cadman words. Everything else is `self_rendered` with the translator's reason. `block_index` is work-level.

Murray quotes the KJV/RV; where Cadman lacks a word his sentence turns on (John 4:23 'seek', Luke 18:7 'long-suffering', John 7:39 'the Spirit was not yet', Rev 1:6 'kings', Matt 6:13 'the evil one'), only Cadman's words sit inside the quotation marks and Murray's point is carried in the prose. The 'LORD, TEACH US TO PRAY' refrain is Cadman's Luke 11:1 in capitals. AI-drafted, awaiting native review; this is the first Vietnamese book.
